funding.name: Arizona Promise Program
funding.provides: A guaranteed scholarship program for eligible low-income Arizona students.
funding.eligibility: Arizona resident and high school graduate with a 2.5 GPA or higher; must receive a federal Pell Grant award; must enroll at Arizona State University, Northern Arizona University or the University of Arizona (per page).
funding.how_to_apply: Complete the FAFSA by April 1 of senior year to receive priority consideration (per page).
